pr_body:
Fixes #32963

The change to support binary literals resulted in lower case b's in hex literals throwing a parse error.
pr_comments:
Looks good to me, but it can be a single commit. So please squash the two commits as described here: http://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/community/contributing/pr_workflow.html#mastering-the-pr-workflow-the-rebase

You can take the opportunity to reword the commit message too. It should [describe the issue that it's fixing and why it works](https://chris.beams.io/posts/git-commit/#seven-rules), not the code change itself (because we can see the code change anyway in the diff).

issue_context.title: Parser won't accept a Base 16 hex literal with a lower case b
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Godot Engine v3.2.alpha.custom_build.3e782c78a - https://godotengine.org
OpenGL ES 3.0 Renderer: AMD Radeon R9 M370X OpenGL Engine

**OS/device including version:**
macOS Mojave 10.14.6 

**Issue description:**

Including a lower case b returns this error in the editor and when you run.

`Parser Error: Parse error: Invalid numeric constant at 'b'`

Changing it to an upper case b removes the error.

**Steps to reproduce:**

Assign a hex integer with a lower case b to a variable.

**Minimal reproduction project:**

New Project
Add Node2D
Save as main
Create new script, main.gd

```
extends Node2D

var x = 0xabcdef

```
Save and run to get the error.

If you change it to

```
extends Node2D

var x = 0xaBcdef

```

The project will successfully run.
comments:
It looks like this commit to add support for binary literals is the culprit.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/d3cc9c0bf191491ea3beaa47c7ba46dcd0af38e2
Line 910 in `gdscript_tokenizer.cpp` I believe. The block just needs a new conditional if already within a hexadecimal literal
Created a PR to fix this #32966

review_comments: One of things that caused this bug is the order of the checks. And if it's already in a hex literal and it's a hex character, better to move on sooner than to spend time on checks later.
